title: eval-harness: add CI hook for prompt-set regression + metrics integration
author: Asha Patel
description:
Adds a new CI hook to the eval-harness that runs prompt-set regression checks and publishes eval metrics summary to CI. Motivation: teams keep hitting subtle prompt regressions when rolling model versions; automating the evaluation and gating in PRs will catch upstream regressions earlier. What this PR does:
- New GH Actions workflow: .github/workflows/eval-prompt-regression.yml that runs lightweight evals on changed prompt-sets + a fast metric summary step.
- New runtime hook: eval-harness/hooks/prompt_regression_hook.py implements a CI-friendly runner and upload to build artifacts.
- Metrics integration: small adapter to push aggregated metrics (EM, BLEU-ish, custom quality scores) into the CI summary and to the eval-metrics pipeline.
- Tests: unit + integration tests exercising the hook and sample prompt-sets.
- Docs: docs/eval/ci_integration.md with setup and sample outputs.
Backwards compatibility: the hook is opt-in and tied to a new repo-level label `eval-ci`; it will not run unless the repo/ORG has enabled the workflow or the label is present. Rollout plan: enable in canary org -> enable for redwood repo -> flip to enforced gating with an A/B for 2 weeks.
Checklist:
- [x] Add GH Action and hook implementation
- [x] Unit tests and basic integration test
- [x] Documentation
- [x] Wire up metrics summary into CI artifacts
Related: ENG-3142 for scoring thresholds, ENG-3189 for canary rollout.
